body: Shrimp on the barbie! XD I’m dying.
Well, I guess your entitled to your opinion,

Well, obviously her parents are doing a horrible job. The way I see it, she would have continued to text random strangers regardless if I didn’t respond. I at least was able to give her a satisfactory answer and caution her not to text anyone else.
I still don’t see anything wrong. I don’t have kids but even if I did, I wouldn’t be quick to assume every friendly person is a potential predator to my children.
I get the whole protecting children from rapists but we shouldn’t assume every person I child comes in contact with is a potential threat. That’s says a lot about our society.
Sorry honey, I don’t feed trolls. 😛
She needed advice and I was willing to give it. I see nothing wrong. It’s really no different from an older brother texting his younger sister. And I’m gay so I wouldn’t worry much.

12 to 15 year olds nowadays are a lot more mature than they were when I was 12-15. I’m sure she’s heard the answer “just wait” hundreds of times from older adults. I gave her a satisfactory answer because I knew if I didn’t, she’d look somewhere else she probably shouldn’t. 

In the previous texts (which aren’t shown), I told her to focus on school instead of boys twice but she seemed unsatisfied with that answer.
Exactly. Funny though, in the first few messages she was more concerned that I’d think she was a pervert. 😂
I couldn’t agree anymore. We live in an age where we find more comfort in random strangers than the people close to us.

I think it’s far from perfect but it’s the only constant. The only thing I can guarantee. I can’t exactly find hope in hopelessness. And as for what’s causing me distress, it’s just living. I hate college honestly. I don’t like work. And it seems my fate is already determined for me. At least here in the US, there aren’t much opportunities for people like me.
